RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 20

The panel's gender composition alone is not evidence of discrimination, and raising it without concrete proof would severely harm your professional reputation. Academic hiring decisions depend on many qualitative factors beyond publication counts, including interview performance, teaching evaluations, departmental fit, and specific strategic needs—such as the selected candidate's industry experience. Furthermore, a two-week delay in receiving administrative feedback is standard in universities. Rather than alleging bias based on the panel's demographics, follow up politely to request constructive feedback on your interviews to strengthen future applications.
